statement: Inside one Entity frame a settle_execute reads the Account mempool as the frame found it: a settle_transition queued by an earlier tx of the same frame is not yet visible to it (og applies queued Account txs after the tx loop), so a user's execute that races the hub scheduler's in one frame is og's no-op skip and its command advances the nonce; it is not refused and evicted.
source: Rig walk settlement 0x30de1 frame 177 (scheduledWake runs the hub scheduler's settle_execute, then the signed command's settle_execute: og skips it as already submitted and commits nonce 41, the rewrite refuses SETTLEMENT_TRANSITION_ALREADY_PENDING and evicts the command, nonce stays 40); og core/entity/tx/handlers/payments/settle.ts:654
